pattern_name: Loop Splitting to Break RAW Dependency (TSVC s1113)
variant_desc: for(i=0;i<N;i++) a[i] = POLY(a[N/2] + b[i]) (scalar chain) -> 3-part split: pre-mid, mid, post-mid (all 4-lane SIMD vectorizable) (variant 2: seed=44, n_scale=1.5x)
novelty_rationale: Tests recognition that a single-iteration RAW dependency at a fixed index (a[N/2]) can be eliminated by splitting the loop into three parts -- before the dependent index (a[mid] is loop-invariant), the dependent iteration (done by hand), and after (a[mid] is a scalar constant). Compilers cannot do this transformation because their may-alias analysis sees the RAW chain and refuses to vectorize the whole loop; they cannot reason about which specific iteration creates the dependency.
